scope: Final comparative revision after retained r1/r2 unloaded diagnostics; relative Gazebo result only, no absolute capacity claim, no 5c-3/5d

prior_pilots.reason_for_r3: legacy P2-44 anti-rebound flap overlapped the new entry functions; r2 one-way flap closed at the front plane and left the ball in the entrance zone

variants.high_hood: legacy flap removed; gentle controlled rise X352/Z23.5 to X250/Z65; roof clear plane Z160-178
variants.one_way_flap: legacy flap removed; 25 g 96x85x2 mm flap hinged at X305/Z165, 0..80 deg inward, damping 0.005 Nms/rad
variants.lip_cover: legacy flap removed; floor rises to Z60 over final 27 mm, 6 mm lip top Z60, light roof/cheeks

delivery_matrix.preload_method: dynamic fall from identical low-discrepancy points in common unobstructed open top; no final grid

ranking_rule: Rank by fully passing conditions, delivery successes, fewer preload-spill and entrance-blocked runs, then motion losses; report all conditions.
physics_limitations: Calibrated tennis_ball_compliant remains only for incoming ground/flywheel interaction.
Basket/entry/ball-ball use uncalibrated native DART rigid contact; relative comparison only.
